newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu ends slightly weaker in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu ends slightly weaker in quiet trading.

text.p: 1350 GMT - The Romanian leu closed on Monday marginally weaker at 7,125/160 to the dollar from its 7,115/150 opening level on a dormant interbank market, traders said.

* They said the leu depreciation was negligible throughout the day. For Tuesday, operators forecast no major developments on leu-dollar rates. They said the central bank (BNR) would continue its policy of draining dollar funds in excess to prevent the leu from firming.
* Traders said surplus dollars came mainly from foreign investors interested in buying Romanian equities.
* On the money market, short term rates stayed unchanged all day. Overnight rates were between 48 and 50 percent, while one-week rates were around 53 percent.
* Traders said the market was liquid in leu funds because of recent BNR dollar purchases and would remain so in the coming days.
* Leu-dollar retail prices stayed around 7,000/7,100. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
